blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday called for an investigation on the possible lapses in the reported departure of gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang from the country. Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla earlier revealed that Ang had already left the country through the “backdoor.” Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida, however, maintained that Ang is still in the Philippines, based on records from the Bureau of Immigration.
